source.title: Quality Prediction in a Mining Process

protocol.bootstrap: 4000 resamples of whole calendar days of the pooled test pairs, seed 20261002
protocol.sampling: median of approximately 180 sensor rows per nominal hour; changing/interpolated lab-label hours excluded
protocol.splits: three disjoint chronological future windows; expanding history; at least 24 h train/test embargo
protocol.interpretation: observational one-plant quality forecast; no causal control effect, recovery or transfer claim
protocol.previous_lab_caveat: persistence and lab-conditioned models assume previous hourly lab assay is already available; reporting latency is not established

held_labels.rule: a run of 3 or more consecutive valid hours with one silica label is a laboratory value carried over; a pair touches a held run when its sensor hour or its laboratory hour sits in one
